notes.title: Update on Release Time! Release imminent!
notes.content:
This is a quick update for all! 

The game has been uploaded. Steam still need to complete the 'review' process. Unfortunately, I had forgotten that the game's Steam page still had some concept artwork in the images, because of this, the review process has been delayed. I am hoping it will be reviewed and ready to go today/tomorrow. Just to give you advance notice that the game might be late in the day tomorrow, or worst case scenario the day after. Apologies for not have a specific time for you, but it's within the next 24-48 hours! I'll keep you updated.

Thank you again for your ongoing patience, we can't wait for you to play!
